title: feat: route gpt-image-2.5 through Azure with OpenAI fallback
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Routes `openai/gpt-image-2.5-flare` and `openai/gpt-image-2.5-sunburst` to separate Azure resources `myceli-prod-img-25-flare-sweden` and `myceli-prod-img-25-sunburst-sweden` (Sweden Central, version 2026-09-08). Addresses #12446 by isolating resource-level blocks. Direct OpenAI remains the hidden fallback on upstream 429.
- Keeps `paidOnly: true`, `priceMultiplier: 1`, no aliases, and OpenAI list costs. Sets **12 RPM per user per model**; hidden OpenAI fallback entries have no additional per-user limiter. Updates Enter's explicit pricing exceptions.
- Uses the two dedicated Azure keys from #14891. Rollout prerequisite: the secret-upload allowlist changes currently in this PR must accompany #14891 before its deployment; otherwise the upload script skips both new keys. Verify the production bindings before promoting the routing change.
- Azure quota remains 12 RPM per model subscription-wide. Separate resources isolate failures without increasing quota; 200 RPM per model was requested on September 14.
- Earlier validation: direct dedicated-deployment probes returned 200; shared-resource E2E verified billing, cache and a three-user burst. Pricing/alias tests: 474 passed in isolation. Fresh CI is required for the updated 12 RPM contract; local Workers tests are blocked by an outdated runtime.

gist.headline: Two blooms, separate roots
gist.blurb: GPT Image 2.5 Flare and Sunburst now grow from their own Azure plots in Sweden. If a plot is briefly full, a quiet OpenAI fallback keeps the pixels moving.
gist.summary: Routed openai/gpt-image-2.5-flare and openai/gpt-image-2.5-sunburst through separate dedicated Azure Sweden Central resources, with direct OpenAI as a hidden upstream-429 fallback and a 12 RPM per-user limit for each model.
gist.impact: Users get more isolated, resilient GPT Image 2.5 generation: a resource-level block on Flare or Sunburst no longer tangles the other model, while each remains available at 12 RPM per user.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the two GPT Image 2.5 variants as distinct glowing code-flowers, one Flare in warm peach and one Sunburst in soft golden yellow, planted in separate labeled garden beds to show isolated Azure resources. Polli tends both beds while a small backup watering pipe from a retro OpenAI terminal quietly activates when one bed is busy; include subtle 12-RPM marker stones, vines, and flowers.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of two separate garden beds growing glowing code-flowers labeled in simple pixel text “FLARE” and “SUNBURST,” each connected to its own small retro Azure-style server hut, while a quiet backup pipe from a terminal provides water when a bed is busy. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny gardener hat and waters the two beds beside small “12 RPM” marker stones. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
